baseline_models.focus_anchor: The demonstrative, the two sign occurrences, the first-person recitation, the truth phrase, the after-construction, and the closing belief verb form one ordered question.
baseline_models.mechanism: Visible markers are followed out in succession under stable correspondence to reality. The question then tests whether any subsequently offered news can produce settled assent after that evidentiary sequence.

activation_trace.role: The branch contributes publicly legible markers, so both occurrences frame the utterance as evidence.

The branch contributes succession after what precedes, placing the rival account downstream of the signs.
The branch contributes heart-settling assent, making receptive uptake rather than novelty the issue.

changed_reading.before: The verse contrasts divine verses with whatever speech comes later.
changed_reading.after: The verse stages an evidentiary sequence: manifest markers are followed out in correspondence with reality, so any downstream account is tested by whether it can settle the heart after that chain.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The signs are recited upon the addressee with a due relation, while the final verb carries a trust-and-security inventory.
baseline_models.mechanism: Recitation can be heard as placing a due claim in the recipient's custody. A right that continues to follow its holder joins obligation with trust, so belief becomes acceptance of a binding and sheltering relation rather than bare agreement.

activation_trace.role: The branch contributes a liability or right that follows its holder, making recital carry an enduring claim.
The branch contributes a fixed due obligation, giving the transmitted signs normative weight.
The branch contributes security, trust, and faithful custody, recasting belief as entry into a dependable relation.

changed_reading.before: Belief is primarily mental assent to a true recitation.
changed_reading.after: Belief is also entrusting oneself to a due claim that has been laid upon the recipient and continues to follow that recipient.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The noun usually rendered as discourse also has a coming-into-existence branch, immediately followed by a word of succession.
baseline_models.mechanism: The question can reach beyond competing speech to competing accounts of occurrence: what new event, or what explanation of becoming, could arise after God and the visible markers with enough force to ground assent?

changed_reading.before: The question asks only which later statement could be believed.
changed_reading.after: The question may also ask which rival account of novelty, causation, or occurrence could remain credible after God and the displayed markers.

context_deltas.mechanism: The descended written composition is followed by markers in the heavens, earth, dispersed life, revival, and changing winds. Recitation therefore expands into an ordered joining of textual delivery and a changing material world, with reasoning binding the sequence against ignorance.

changed_reading.after: The first-person verb can also organize a text-world sequence in which written delivery and changing creation are followed out as mutually corresponding markers.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same recital reaches the auditory channel twice, yet tightened persistence and self-magnification prevent compliant understanding and convert a known sign into mockery. Belief is therefore not exposure but the successful passage from hearing into secure uptake.

changed_reading.after: Auditory contact can leave belief untouched; belief names compliant, trust-forming uptake, while persistence can knot the channel and turn knowledge into mockery.

context_deltas.mechanism: Subjection opens a usable route: vessels flow, people seek bounty, and the dispersed domains are gathered for repeated reflection. A sign is thus not only an object to inspect but an enabled relation whose path can be followed in practice.

context_deltas.mechanism: What follows the signs is not an empty interval for arbitrary speech. Expectation of decisive days, recompense for acquisition, return, and disagreement after knowledge turn succession into accountable aftermath; the due claim of recital follows the hearer into response and judgment.

changed_reading.after: The sharpest rival is an account that becomes a governing course: it is followed, adjudicates, and directs desire, perception, and communal difference.

The repeated after-God guidance question makes the focus question diagnostic of receptor architecture: no account can settle the heart when self-direction has closed the channels by which markers are received.

strongest_changes: Recitation expanded from oral delivery into an ordered text-world sequence whose changing material domains correspond with the written signs.
Belief shifted from bare assent to receptor and trust architecture: hearing can be blocked, while trust enters a protective relation.
The challenged discourse became both a rival normative track and a rival causal account of mortality and occurrence.
The speaking and transcribed book turned present recital into the first phase of a later reality-corresponding ledger.
summary.what_was_special: The packet kept several tensions live: textual and material signs, assent and custody, temporal succession and accountable aftermath, speech and event, present recital and later record. Non-dominant mappings supplied a visible-mark reading for the heavens and a contained poured-recital image; the sign inventory's interrogative branch and the discourse inventory's heart-polishing branch were preserved as qualified outliers rather than normalized away.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the non-dominant material overlay on the recitation root is genuinely productive or only formally available.
Whether the focus after-construction is best heard as temporal succession, authority ranking, accountable aftermath, or a secondary resonance of relational distance.
Whether the later speaking action-register is the same referential book as the present recital or a deliberately analogous but distinct record.
Whether the sealed-channel sequence explains refusal causally or describes judgment after an already completed refusal.
